request.reason: The exact-head quality workflow's hosted Runtime verification is its first required quality step. On this exact PR head, Runtime rejected run_preflight and run_verification because the same Contract made successful exact-head CI a required pre-verification scenario and numbered acceptance item; repository gates and all 13 package-coverage checks were consequently skipped. Keep exact-head CI, every required gate, and 13-package coverage as mandatory before PR ready/normal merge, but move that external result after admitted Work Item verification. Keep the pre-verification numbered evidence limited to facts available before the check: stable identity, non-blocking independent agent review, and the bound pre-tag release plan/provider identity. The v1.0.0 API reports immutable:false; record that provider fact honestly and use its existing public stable identity as a no-write N-1 reference. This repairs ordering and factual wording without weakening no-overwrite protection or release/merge gates.
